sources.title: GitHub - imperatormk/coreml-birefnet
sources.snippet: BiRefNet on Apple Silicon - ANE/GPU/CPU Investigation This repo investigates whether BiRefNet (a Swin-Transformer-based segmentation model with deformable convolutions) can be made fast on Apple Silicon - specifically, whether it can run on the Apple Neural Engine.

sources.title: The open-source model behind most AI background removers.
sources.snippet: The Open Source Model Powering Most AI Background Removers If you've used any AI background removal tool in the past year—whether it's a web app, a photoshop plugin, or a mobile filter—there's a good chance it's running on BiRefNet under the hood.
